name: bollinger_ema_sar_v1_1_slope_ab
purpose: Test only the interpretation of 'operate if and only if there is slope' while holding every other v1 rule fixed.
fixed_from_v1: rocket rejection wick >=70% of body OR body engulfing
LONG signal low > prior low; SHORT signal high < prior high
stop at low/high of candle immediately before signal candle
target 40% of Bollinger bandwidth at signal close

slope_variants.monotonic3_baseline: Original v1: EMA20 must rise/fall on each of the last 3 closed transitions.
slope_variants.current_slope: Literal slope at signal: LONG EMA20[t] > EMA20[t-1]; SHORT EMA20[t] < EMA20[t-1].
slope_variants.net3_slope: Smoothed direction without monotonic requirement: LONG EMA20[t] > EMA20[t-3]; SHORT EMA20[t] < EMA20[t-3].

selection_rule: This is a diagnostic discovery comparison. Do not select a variant on PnL alone; compare sample size, expectancy, PF, drawdown, direction balance, session concentration, and stability before any confirmatory promotion.
session_rule: No hard 09:00-12:00 ET gate. NY anchor remains contextual only.
live_rule: No live trading implied or enabled.
